General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part covers the Metal Edge Inside the Drivers Door Opening on Soft Top Models.
Slips over Metal Edge in the Door opening.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Edge Trim, Drivers Door
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
